response.answer: Mostly, but not exactly. For 12–18 October, Orbit Electronics has 285 successful orders and 285 settled transactions, so the counts match. The amounts differ: successful orders total ₹5,085,470.47, while settled gross is ₹5,074,271.13, leaving ₹11,199.34 (about 0.22%) in orders that is not reflected in the settled gross. Settlements cover the full period (12–18 October). The data doesn't say why the amounts differ; possible causes include refunds, adjustments or amount differences between orders and settlement records, so that gap is worth investigating.
